`@openvireo/sdk/testing` has an in-memory account server and sync server that speak the real protocol
(OPAQUE, sealed keys, conditional uploads), so tests run the SDK end to end without a network. They are for
tests only: they keep everything in memory and skip checks a real server makes.

```ts {linenos=false}
import { Account } from "@openvireo/sdk";
import { FakeAuthServer, FakeSyncServer, ISSUER } from "@openvireo/sdk/testing";

const auth = new FakeAuthServer();
const sync = new FakeSyncServer();
auth.onToken = (token) => sync.tokens.add(token);   // the sync server accepts the auth server's tokens

// The fake servers live at https://auth.example and https://sync.example
const fetch = (url: string, init?: RequestInit) =>
  new URL(url).host === "sync.example" ? sync.fetch(url, init) : auth.fetch(url, init);

const alice = await Account.connect({ issuer: ISSUER, fetch, device: { name: "test", platform: "web" } });
const { secretKey } = await alice.register({ email: "alice@example.com", password: "correct horse" });

const vault = await alice.createVault("Personal");
await vault.write("ov://Personal/GitHub/password", "hunter2", { create: true });

const bob = await Account.connect({ issuer: ISSUER, fetch, device: { name: "test", platform: "web" } });
await bob.login({ email: "alice@example.com", password: "correct horse", secretKey });
const copy = await bob.openVault(vault.id);
expect(copy.read("ov://Personal/GitHub/password")).toBe("hunter2");
```

Every `Account`, `ServiceAccount` and `SelfHostedSync` takes a `fetch` option, which is how the fakes plug in.

### Useful hooks {#useful-hooks}

| | |
|---|---|
| `sync.afterGet = async (key) => { … }` | Runs after a download and before the upload: write another version here (`sync.store(key, bytes)`) to test a conflict |
| `sync.blobs` | Every stored version, by key (`vaults/<id>` or a database path) |
| `sync.pairing` | Pairing codes for `SelfHostedSync.pair` (`ABCD-EFGH` is there by default) |
| `auth.totp.set(email, code)` | Turns on two-factor authentication for a user |
| `auth.addMember(orgId, email, role)` | Adds an accepted org member without the invitation email |
| `auth.approveReset(email, { delaySeconds })` | Approves an account recovery and returns the `ov_rc_` token |
| `auth.calls`, `sync.calls` | Every request the fakes received, to assert on |

`MockServer`, `json` and `bytes` build small fakes of your own for other routes.

The fake sync server doesn't check vault roles from the token. The SDK's own tests wrap it to do so (see
`packages/sdk/test/helpers/world.ts`); do the same if your test depends on a `403`.
